texts: Chris Olave has 36 targets in three games and one touchdown. The box score hasn't caught up to the usage, and that gap is your buying window. Trade for him today. Let's get to it. #Saints

Buy: Chris Olave, NO WR. 13, 10 and 13 targets, 375 yards, 1 TD. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and a bench RB.
Buy: Saquon Barkley, PHI RB. Zero TDs, but 82 yards on 15 carries @CHI once the stinger cleared. Trade for him; offer a WR2. #Saints #FlyEaglesFly

Buy: Ashton Jeanty, LV RB. 20-plus touches in all three games, 3.3 yards per carry, no rushing TD yet. Trade for him; offer a low-end WR1.
Buy: Jordan Love, GB QB. 124 throws in three games, 6 TDs. Trade for him; offer a bench WR. #RaiderNation #GoPackGo

Sell: Jake Ferguson, DAL TE. 3 TDs on 11 targets and 72 yards. Trade him away; ask for a TE with steady targets or a WR3.
Sell: Aaron Jones Sr., MIN RB. The lead job lasts until Jordan Mason is back in Week 7. Trade him away; ask for a RB2. #DallasCowboys #Skol

Sell: Emeka Egbuka, TB WR. Mayfield is out at least three weeks and an undrafted rookie starts. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.
Sell: Omarion Hampton, LAC RB. Snap share fell from 80.6 to 42 percent, with 6 routes in Week 3. Trade him away. #GoBucs #BoltUp
The one trade to make today: Olave. His managers see one touchdown; you see 36 targets. Offer a WR2 and a bench RB, and go up to a WR2 plus a flex if they push back. #Saints
